items.title: CrowdStrike Sees a Path to the “Largest AI Safety and Security Company” Ever. Zscaler Must Deliver $1 Billion of Synergies
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCrowdStrike agreed to buy Zscaler for $43. 9 billion in stock and targets about $1 billion of yearly revenue synergies.

items.title: Shots Fired: Zscaler CEO Says a Rival Platform’s Only Benefit Was “an Integrated Invoice.” That’s a Problem for Palo Alto
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCrowdStrike is buying Zscaler for $43. 9 billion in stock, and on the deal call Zscaler CEO Jay Chaudhry described a firewall vendor’s platform whose only benefit was an integrated invoice.

items.title: CrowdStrike’s all-stock bid for Zscaler: deal structure shifts risk to target holders
items.summary: Investing.com -- CrowdStrike’s all-stock bid for Zscaler puts the price risk squarely on Zscaler shareholders, and the market is already pricing that in.
